description:
For clients that connect with an API key rather than OAuth: exchanges a
pairing code from the user's account page for an API key. Destructive: it
issues a new key and immediately revokes the account's previous one, so
any other client still using the old key stops working. OAuth connections
are not affected.

The key is returned once and cannot be retrieved later; only a hash of it
is stored. It is sent as the `X-API-Key` header on MCP and REST
requests. Codes are single-use, expire after 15 minutes, and are
invalidated after a few wrong attempts.
name: rayana_ai_complete_setup

outputSchema.description: The result of redeeming a pairing code: a usable API key, once.
